description: Starter gold corpus for RFQ extraction. These cases were written alongside the rule-based extractor, so they are a regression set, not a held-out benchmark: replace or extend them with real, permitted customer RFQs (activity B) before treating gate H as evidence of accuracy.

cases.text:
RFQ: BLE asset tracker
Customer: Acme Logistics
Quantity: 5,000 units
Supply voltage: 3.3 V
Max current: 150 mA
Power budget: 0.6 W
Operating temperature: -20 to 60 °C
Board size: 45 x 30 mm
Interfaces: BLE 5.0, UART, I2C
Certifications: CE, FCC, RoHS
Target unit price: USD 12.50

Project - Smart meter comms board
Annual volume: 20k
Input voltage: 3V3
Peak current: 0.8 A
Operating temp: -40°C ~ +85°C
PCB size: 85mm x 65mm
Connectivity: LoRa; RS-485; Modbus
Compliance: IEC 62368-1, CE

We need 1200 boards for an industrial gateway powered from a 24 V supply. Typical current draw is 350 mA. The unit must operate from -25 to 70 °C and fit on a 100 x 80 mm PCB. It needs Ethernet and CAN, and must be CE and UL certified.

Qty: 300 pcs
VIN: 48 V
Power: 1.2 kW
Operating temperature: 0 to 50 C
Interfaces: CAN, USB
Target price: INR 4,500

Requirement summary for wearable patch

Looking for a quote on 750 units of a motor controller. Input voltage is 12 V nominal and the controller may draw up to 5 A. Total power budget 60 W. Ambient range -10 to 55 °C. Interfaces required: CAN and UART. Needs RoHS and REACH compliance.
